self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Diffusing Boundary: While the wielder is protected by a Shield, Normal and Charged Attack DMG is increased by 40%, and Normal and Charged Attack CRIT Rate is increased by 16%.

en.flavor: A ceremonial blade forged by Sanhaj, the great high priest of the Masters of the Night-Wind. In tales of bygone days, Sanhaj could use this curved blade to perform rituals, blurring the boundary between the Night Kingdom and the present world.

fr.flavor: Une lame cérémonielle forgée par Sanhaj, le grand prêtre des Maîtres du vent nocturne. Dans les contes d'autrefois, Sanhaj pouvait utiliser cette lame courbée pour accomplir des rituels, brouillant ainsi la frontière entre le Fief nocturne et le monde actuel.
